content.text:
**Top pick: Sony WF-1000XM6, about $330 (MSRP)**
- Several 2026 roundups name it the best overall. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/wireless-earbuds) calls it the best earbuds it has tested, mainly for its noise cancellation. [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-wireless-earbuds-budget-and-premium) calls it the benchmark for sound quality at this level.
- It works with both iPhone and Android, though iPhone users give up some of Apple's tight integration.

**Alternative 1: Apple AirPods Pro 3, about $249**
- This is the best choice if you use an iPhone. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-wireless-earbuds,review-6160.html) tested the new Sony, Apple and Bose flagships, and it ranked the AirPods Pro 3 first.
- Battery life is a noted weakness.
- One roundup lists the price as $299, so check the current price.

**Alternative 2: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen), price not confirmed**
- Choose these if noise cancellation matters most to you. [TechGearLab](https://www.techgearlab.com/topics/audio/best-wireless-earbuds) names them best overall, but that list is about five months old.
- I couldn't find a reliable current price, so check a retailer.

**Cheaper options:** [Trusted Reviews](https://www.trustedreviews.com/best/best-wireless-earbuds-3442893) picks the Sony WF-C710N as the best budget pair. The [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2274988/best-wireless-earbuds-2026/) roundup mentions the EarFun Air Pro 4 Plus and Anker Soundcore Space A40. I didn't find prices for any of these.

**About the prices:** The review pages I opened didn't list prices, and the roundups disagreed with each other. The Sony and Apple figures come from secondhand roundups (for example, [this one](https://designbeep.com/?p=127113)), so confirm them before you buy.

If you tell me your phone and your budget, I can narrow this down.
